generationInputs.prompt: A cinematic underwater scene unfolds with a wide-angle shot, capturing the mystical ambiance. The neon blue text "NAUTILUS" slowly fades into the dark abyss. A male diver in full metallic silver diving gear with an old-school helmet and a clear visor, swims slowly from the left, holding a bright flashlight. He points the light towards a glowing seahorse of blue and green hues and a closed treasure chest. The seahorse, with its vivid bioluminescence, swims and dances around the chest. The treasure chest, resting on a rock, emits a warm orange glow from its keyhole in the shape of a microphone. Air bubbles drift upwards from the diver and the chest, creating a mesmerizing dance of light and shadow. The scene is lit by the diver's flashlight and the glowing objects, creating a stunning contrast against the dark blue water.
